name: sk-tab-bar
title: Custom Tab Bar
description: A custom tab bar where the selection indicator *travels* between tabs rather than cutting. That is `matchedGeometryEffect` doing the work: one pill exists at a time and SwiftUI interpolates its frame, which is both cheaper and smoother than animating an offset you calculate yourself.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKTabBar(selection: $tab, tabs: [
.init(tab: .home,    title: "Home",    systemImage: "house.fill"),
.init(tab: .search,  title: "Search",  systemImage: "magnifyingglass"),
.init(tab: .profile, title: "Profile", systemImage: "person.fill"),
])
